name: Amulet of the Devout, +2

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

powers.name: Channel Divinity
powers.text: Once per dawn, regain one use of Channel Divinity.

summary: +2 to your Cleric and Paladin spell attacks and save DC; once a day, a use of Channel Divinity back.
text: A deity's emblem worked in gems or precious metal decorates this amulet. While you wear it, your Cleric and Paladin spells gain +2 to their spell attack rolls and their saving throw DCs. Once per dawn, it also lets you use Channel Divinity without spending a use of that feature.
